title: This is pretty awful to work with
text: This is pretty awful to work with. I have used several window tints and managed the work myself on windows and large doors without a lot of problems. I still have my installation kits, so I thought this would be a breeze. It is not. It is very heavy in comparison to most tint film and even with sharp tools, the ridges keep it from cutting evenly. The edges look quite bad against the light. As someone else suggested, I used black electrical tape to fully block light on the edges and to get a clean look. If you've never used tint, this will be a ruff install.
